finding.summary: Worker A Test Center profiles declare environmentAllowlist, but run_profile executes subprocesses with os.environ.copy(). Undeclared credentials and secrets can influence execution and leak into uploaded logs while the evidence digest records only allowlisted variables.

nextAction: MISSION-015 adds the three exact paths to MISSION-001 owned paths, validates delivery control, and records the policy identity. Worker A then publishes the already prepared focused security repair from the frozen PR #64 base, runs ownership/review-impact checks, exact-head CI, and fresh Worker B/J/I review.

plannedRepair.baseline: Use a documented minimal cross-platform child environment with controlled HOME/temp paths, deterministic Python encoding, inherited executable-resolution variables, and Windows process-launch variables only where required.
plannedRepair.environmentEvidence: Digest and record every variable visible to the child, including baseline and explicitly allowed values.
negativeRegressions: undeclared sentinel secret is absent in the child
every visible child variable is represented in environment evidence
Linux, macOS, and Windows baseline differences are deterministic
sensitive output is redacted before artifact persistence
duplicate, wildcard, and security-sensitive allowlist expansion is rejected
plannedRepair.outputBoundary: Redact known parent sensitive values and bound captured output before writing evidence logs.

request.scopeRule: Exact paths only; do not grant tool/worker_a*.py or .github/workflows/worker-a*.yml broadly.

supportBoundary: Source security repair only. No P2 behavior, platform, capability, release, production, GA, P3, P11, ready, or merge promotion.
